notes.title: YUREI HUNT IS NOW FREE TO PLAY – FOREVER!
notes.notes:
[p][b]👻 YUREI HUNT IS NOW FREE TO PLAY – FOREVER![/b]
We’re excited to announce that [i]Yurei Hunt[/i] is now completely [b]free to play[/b], permanently! Whether you're new or returning, now’s the perfect time to jump in and join the hunt.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]💌 To Our Early Supporters:[/b]
If you bought the game before this change, thank you. Your early support kept us going. You’ll be [b]credited in-game soon[/b] as a sign of our appreciation. Want to make sure your name is listed? Reach out on discord and we’ll confirm it.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🛠️ We Know We've Been Behind…[/b]
We’ve been slow getting through the roadmap, and we appreciate your patience. But we’re [b]back on track now[/b], and development is moving forward again with full force. Expect new updates and improvements soon.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🧪 Found a Bug?[/b]
Please report any issues on our Discord. Every bug you catch helps us make the game better for everyone.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🎯 New to Yurei Hunt?[/b]
Now's the best time to try it, [b]gather your friends and dive in for free.[/b] Chase or be chased in chaotic, ghost-filled rounds across eerie Japanese-inspired maps.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thanks again for sticking with us, this is just the beginning of what's to come.[/p][p]
– [i]The 71 Studios Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Yurei Hunt Launch Event
notes.notes:
[h1]👻 Yurei Hunt is Now in Early Access![/h1]

Yurei Hunt is a Japanese-themed prop hunt game where ghosts hide as everyday objects, and hunters try to find them before time runs out. It's spooky, fun, and full of surprises, and it’s available now in Early Access!

[h2]🕹️ What’s the Game About?[/h2]
👻 Play as a ghost and disguise yourself as props around the map.

🏹 Or play as a hunter and track the ghosts down before time runs out.

🌸 Explore beautiful, stylized maps inspired by Japanese culture and supernatural folklore.


[h2]🚧 Early Access & Roadmap[/h2]
We’re launching in Early Access to build the game with your feedback. The core game is already fun and playable, but we have a lot more planned!


[h2]📜 Our roadmap[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516065/db8d2f79abbcdc56c440f4365720d8f0ae4ebe31.png[/img]

[b]💸 Launch Offer – 40% Off![/b]
To celebrate the launch, Yurei Hunt is available at 40% off for a limited time!

It’s the perfect time to jump in and try the game.

[b]💬 Join our community on Discord[/b]

https://discord.gg/BwjF8X485a

Let the hunt begin!
— The 71 Studios Team
